emergencyStop(bytes32[]).details: An empty list only disables updates. An unregistered id reverts the whole call.

latestRoundData(bytes32).details: Unknown feeds return all zeros; stopped feeds retain round ids but have zero answer and timestamps.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.feedIds: Feed identifiers, conventionally keccak256 of the pair (e.g. "INR/USD").
params.observedAt: Provider observation time, strictly newer per feed and not in the future.

AnswerOutOfBand(bytes32,uint64,uint64,ui.notice: The answer is outside the available rolling band.

AnswerOutOfLimits(bytes32,uint64).notice: The answer is outside the feed's inclusive limits.

EmptyBatch().notice: An update batch must contain at least one feed.

FeedAlreadyRegistered(bytes32).notice: The requested feed is already registered.

FeedLocked(bytes32).notice: The feed must be seeded before accepting updater writes.

FeedNotRegistered(bytes32).notice: The requested feed has not been registered.

InvalidLimits(uint64,uint64).notice: Limits must satisfy zero < minimum <= maximum.

LengthMismatch(uint256,uint256).notice: Feed and answer array lengths differ.

NotUpdater(address).notice: The caller is not the configured updater.

ObservationNotNewer(bytes32,uint64,uint6.notice: The provider observation must be strictly newer than the latest round.

ObservedAtInFuture(uint64).notice: The provider observation is later than the current block.

ZeroUpdater().notice: An updater assignment cannot use the zero address.

AnswerUpdated(bytes32,uint64,uint64,uint.notice: Emitted for each seed or updater round.

EmergencyStopped(address,bytes32[]).notice: Emitted when updates are disabled and the listed feeds are locked.

FeedAdded(bytes32,uint64,uint64).notice: Emitted when a feed is registered in a locked state.

FeedLimitsSet(bytes32,uint64,uint64).notice: Emitted when the owner changes a feed's inclusive limits.

FeedSeeded(bytes32,uint64,uint64).notice: Emitted when the owner seeds and unlocks a feed.

UpdaterSet(address,address).notice: Emitted when the updater changes; zero disables updates.

addFeed(bytes32,uint64,uint64).notice: Registers a locked feed with positive inclusive limits; owner only.

constructor.notice: Initializes the store with the deployer as owner and a nonzero updater.

decimals().notice: Returns the fixed answer precision of eight decimals.

emergencyStop(bytes32[]).notice: Disables the updater and clears prices/timestamps of listed feeds, retaining round ids; owner only.

getBand(bytes32).notice: Returns band availability and inclusive bounds, excluding observation-time eligibility.

getFeedConfig(bytes32).notice: Returns stored configuration; unknown feeds return the zero-valued struct.

latestRoundData(bytes32).notice: Returns the latest Chainlink-shaped tuple, with both timestamps equal and answeredInRound = roundId.

renounceOwnership().notice: Always reverts to preserve owner access to seeding and emergency controls.

seedFeed(bytes32,uint64).notice: Publishes an in-limit seed at block time and unlocks the feed; owner only.

setFeedLimits(bytes32,uint64,uint64).notice: Changes inclusive limits without changing the latest round; owner only.

setUpdater(address).notice: Assigns a nonzero updater; owner only.

updateRates(bytes32[],uint64[],uint64).notice: Atomically publishes answers for registered, unlocked feeds as the updater.

updater().notice: Returns the authorized updater, or zero when updates are disabled.

userdoc.notice: Owner-configured FX rounds published by a single updater.
